estimand: Distinct advert IDs never obtaining a successful full record because of the outage, relative to ordinary daily capture; not positions, not missed daily observations.

id_evidence.upper_bound_caveat: Conditional allocation-span ceiling, not an unconditional bound on all published adverts. Slots can be drafts/deletions and older IDs can be republished.

pooled_all.resampling_note: Descriptive independent-day sensitivity, not a formal uncertainty interval; it omits seasonality and serial correlation.

historical_outage_experiments.caveat: Windows overlap; descriptive sensitivity ranges are not independent-sample confidence intervals. Windows end before the real billing interruption. Captures on the restart day are included in both actual and simulated cohorts.

observed_span_approximation.caveat: First-to-last span can bridge interrupted listings; use historical daily masking as primary duration evidence.

archive_size_estimates.note: 189 older local pages; illustrative sizing, not measured current storage. Full daily raw pages include changing application tokens, so exact-byte hashes alone may not deduplicate them.
archive_size_estimates.artifact_caveat: Potential recoverable source coverage inferred from successful runs and workflow upload paths; artifacts not downloaded or individually verified.

working_estimate.basis: Rounded central planning estimate from nearby publishing rates (about 80), matched ID-span calibration (about 78), and weekday-matched historical outage experiments (about 64). Methods are dependent; this is not a statistical meta-analysis or confidence interval.
